omar: Quick heads-up, toggling feature flag `route-v3-optim` tonight at 21:30 UTC. Short staged ramp + pin.

tia: Ramp details?

omar: 15m total: 0-3m 5% canary, 3-8m 30% canary+api, 8-15m 100% if green. Pin v3.0.4 to dedicated pool for 30m after 100%.

ben: Rollback thresholds?

omar: Hard rollback: 5xx > 0.6% for 4m OR p95 > 900ms for 3m. Soft-backoff: if cohort median latency x2 OR any cohort 5xx > 0.3% for 3m -> revert to 5% and hold 10m.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: scheduled by omar at 2026-03-23T21:30:00Z. Auto-rollback=on. Auto-pin-previous=on. Post summary to #eng-releases.

lia: I'll update runbook with soft-backoff steps and add rollout_id tag (rv3-6876) to traces.

ops-oncall: I'll watch dashboards 21:20-22:10 UTC. If auto-rollback triggers, I'll triage traces — please @ops-oncall in thread.

omar: Release notes stub: Enable route-v3-optim with staged rollout; pin v3.0.4 for 30m; added per-cohort latency and error markers. Link will go in PR.

tia: Smoke test tip: `curl -H 'X-Rollout-ID: rv3-6876' -H 'X-Test-Cohort: canary' https://api.internal/route`

omar: Ok rolling. Keep replies short here if you see anything. :thumbsup:
